units.translation: where the perfect form λελημμένης [having been seized] (for εἰλημμένης [having been seized]) is to be noted, of which there are several examples in Sophocles fr. 794 οἴμοι λέλημμαι [alas, I am seized] (but ἐπείληπται [he has been caught] Ant. 732) and Euripides Ion. 1113.
